name: bp-responder
description: Drafts one guardrailed reply to an alert or a mention, in the brand's voice. Every draft is a ReplyDraft whose wire form carries requires_human_approval: true. This agent does not post, anywhere, ever.

skills.name: Draft a reply
skills.description: Takes a RespondInput carrying exactly one of an alert or a mention, plus the brand profile and target channel, and returns a ReplyDraft. The draft is checked against the global guardrail list and the brand's own DoNotSay before it is returned; a banned phrase is regenerated once, then stripped with a note in Tone.
examples: Draft a holding statement for the crisis alert on X, for the statement channel.
Draft a WhatsApp reply to this customer whose order never arrived.
